name: sedan
description: Classic full-size saloon: long, fairly high bonnet with a steep nose, raked windscreen. Typical adult impact: legs at the bumper, pelvis at the bonnet edge, torso and head onto the bonnet.
space: Vehicle space: metres, origin = ground point under the vehicle's centre; forward = driving direction. Angles in degrees: hood_angle = rise of the bonnet towards the windscreen, windshield_angle = from horizontal. brake_decel = emergency braking on a dry road, m/s^2 (own generic values: about 0.7 g for cars, after the 0.7 g used in published reconstructions; less for heavy vehicles).
sources: Own generic class dimensions, rounded from aggregate measurements (medians per class) of the vehicles of a game-scale world whose people stand about 1.93 m (ADR-0014, founder decision 2026-11-18). No game data or shapes are included.
